summary: Iteration 14 — Jersey Math bonus mini-game validated end-to-end. Backend POST /api/players/{id}/jersey-math: 9/9 pytest cases pass, including all six spec cases {7,2}->70, {5,5}->10, {10,0}->100, {2,3}->20, {0,10}->10, {0,0}->0; clamping (-5,-3)->(0,0)->0; (999,0)->(10,0)->100; unknown player -> 404; player.coins increases by exactly coins_awarded (verified with GET). Frontend /jersey-math renders the 'N / 10' counter starting 1/10, an equation card 'a ± b = ?', a timer-bar testID, and exactly 6 unique jersey-<n> options containing the correct answer. Playthrough tapping correct jerseys advances questions and increments ✓; a Q5 timer expiration correctly counted as ✗ and advanced to Q6. Result screen (jersey-math-result) showed correct coins per rule in two runs: 10 correct/0 wrong -> +100, and 9 correct/1 wrong -> reward matched formula (no player id path returns +0, expected). Continue (jersey-math-continue) navigates to /level-map. Trigger logic verified on cooking-result: level=3 win renders bonus-banner ('BONUS ROUND NEXT!') with Continue label 'Bonus Round!' and routes to /jersey-math; level=2 win hides the banner and routes to /level-map. Backend coin balance verified via GET after frontend gameplay (100 -> 200).

react_native_issues.issue: Web console warns 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'textShadow*' deprecated (use textShadow). Pre-existing, not specific to jersey-math.
Web console warns Image style.resizeMode is deprecated; use props.resizeMode. Pre-existing.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add a small 'no player id — please onboard first' guard on jersey-math to avoid the 0-coin silent path when the screen is opened without an active player.
(Pre-existing / cross-app) Migrate shadow*, textShadow*, and Image style.resizeMode to their non-deprecated forms to clear React Native Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: jersey-math.tsx makeQuestion() only guarantees 6 unique options in [0..25] including the answer; wrong deltas are ±1..6 so distractors stay close to the answer (good UX).
handlePick locks via lockedRef and finishes with a 650ms flash before advance — matches spec.
handleTimeout increments wrong and advances — confirmed via runtime test on Q5.
cooking-result.tsx: bonusAfterThis = win && retryLevel === 3 — spec matches exactly; unlockBanner still shows Donuts (level 4) alongside bonus-banner which is fine.
api.ts jerseyMath posts {correct,wrong} and reads coins_awarded/correct/wrong/player — matches server contract.
seed_data_creation: Created two anonymous test players via POST /api/players (TEST_JM, TEST_JMWeb). No production data touched.
